description: This file defines a class PSCSR containing static methods and properties that provide resource or validation messages related to charting in the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: PSCSR
classes.description: A class providing static methods and properties for resource messages in the PDFsharp charting component.

methods.name: InvalidChartTypeForCombination
methods.description: Returns an error message indicating an invalid chart type for combination.

methods.name: PercentNotSupportedByColumnDataLabel
methods.description: Property returning an error message for unsupported 'Percent' data label setting.

methods.name: RenderInfoNotInitialized
methods.description: Returns an error message indicating that render information for a specific type is not initialized.
